Briton Harriet Dart Reaches First WTA Tour Singles Final at Guangzhou Open

31 Oct 2026, 07:01 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Image: www.bbc.co.uk · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

Key takeaways Historic Breakthrough in Guangzhou British tennis player Harriet Dart has reached her first WTA Tour singles final following a hard-fought three-set victory over Chinese wildcard Sun Xinran at the Guangzhou Open. According to the BBC, the 30-year-old qualifier secured

Historic Breakthrough in Guangzhou

British tennis player Harriet Dart has reached her first WTA Tour singles final following a hard-fought three-set victory over Chinese wildcard Sun Xinran at the Guangzhou Open. According to the BBC, the 30-year-old qualifier secured a 5-7, 7-6 (7-1), 6-0 win in just under two and a half hours.

Dart, who made her tour-level debut in 2015, previously reached six doubles finals—winning two titles—but had only advanced to one previous singles semi-final at the 2024 Transylvania Open.

Match Breakdown and Comeback

  • First Set: Dart fell behind 3-0 early before battling back to lead 5-4. However, she struggled with double faults while serving for the set, allowing 16-year-old Sun Xinran to claim the opener 7-5.
  • Second Set: Dart traded early breaks with her opponent and was forced to serve to stay in the match twice. She recovered to dominate the tie-break 7-1.
  • Third Set: Following a medical timeout for Sun regarding her left leg, Dart controlled the decider, winning 28 of 41 points to seal a bagel third set.

Rankings and Next Steps

Following this performance, live standings indicate Dart has climbed 14 places to 101st in the WTA rankings. A victory in Sunday's final against either fourth seed Lilli Tagger or Kaitlin Quevedo would secure her return to the top 100.

Reflecting on her milestone achievement, Dart told reporters it was a "rollercoaster" match and that reaching the final "means the world" after a long career journey.
